title: Find K Closest Elements
description: Given a sorted integer array arr, two integers k and x, return the k closest integers to x in the array. The result should also be sorted in ascending order. An integer a is closer to x than b if |a - x| < |b - x|, or |a - x| == |b - x| and a < b.
